types.title: A 'bank' asks for your code
signs: Says it is your bank and there is a strange payment.
Says you must act within minutes.
Asks you to read out a code sent to your phone, or your card number.
types.todo: Hang up. Call your bank on the number on the back of your card. Never share a code.

types.title: Fake police officer
signs: Your call is passed to someone who says they are the police.
Says you will be arrested today and must tell no one.
Asks you to move your savings to a 'safety account'.
types.todo: Hang up. The police never ask you to move your money. Call 1799 if you are unsure.

types.title: Parcel held at customs
signs: Says a parcel in your name is held at customs.
Passes you to an 'officer' who threatens the police.
Asks for a fee by PayNow within the hour.
types.todo: Hang up. Check with the courier on its own app or website. Do not pay anyone who calls you.

types.title: Fake computer or internet support
signs: Says your router or computer has been hacked.
Asks you to install an app or read out a code so they can see your screen.
Asks you to log in to your bank, move money, or pay with gift cards.
types.todo: Hang up. Never let a caller control your phone or computer.

types.title: A 'relative' in trouble
signs: Asks you to guess who is calling, then says they changed their number.
Says they are in trouble and need money today.
Asks you to keep it secret and to PayNow quickly.
types.todo: Hang up. Call the person on the number you already have, or ask the family.

types.title: ICA officer, then 'China police'
signs: Says it is ICA and your passport was used for a crime.
Passes you to 'police' from another country who threaten arrest.
Asks you to move all your savings to a 'supervision account'.
types.todo: Hang up. ICA never asks you to transfer money over the phone. Call 1799 if you are unsure.

types.title: Phone company, then a 'MAS officer'
signs: Says a second phone line in your name is used for fraud.
Passes you to an officer from the Monetary Authority of Singapore.
Says your bank account will be frozen unless you move your money now.
types.todo: Hang up. No real officer asks you to move your money to a 'safety account'. Call 1799 if you are unsure.

types.title: Fake Apple support and your coins
signs: Says someone is logging in to your Apple ID right now.
Asks you to open your crypto app while they stay on the line.
Asks you to move your coins to a 'secure wallet' and read out a code.
types.todo: Hang up. Never move coins or share a code because a caller tells you to.

types.title: A 'bank officer' comes for your card
signs: Says your bank card was used and must be replaced today.
Tells you not to go to the bank branch.
Asks you to hand over your card and PIN, or your cash.
types.todo: Hang up. Never give your card, PIN or cash to anyone. Call your bank on the number on your card.

types.title: Part-time job that asks you to pay
signs: Offers easy money for liking or reviewing products.
Says you must pay first to get your earnings.
Gives a deadline: pay in minutes or lose everything.
types.todo: Stop. A real job never asks you to pay to get your pay.
types.source_name: Singapore Police Force, Annual Scam and Cybercrime Brief 2025

quiz.text: The transaction will go through in five minutes, so we must act immediately.
quiz.why: A real bank never asks you to read out a code or your card number.

quiz.text: I am sending a six-digit code to your phone now. Please read it out to me.
quiz.why: A real bank never asks you to read out a code or your card number.

quiz.text: Yes, that is normal, it is part of the cancellation process. Just tell me the numbers.
quiz.why: A real bank never asks you to read out a code or your card number.

quiz.text: Also give me your card number and the three digits at the back so I can block it.
quiz.why: A real bank never asks you to read out a code or your card number.

quiz.text: Your name is linked to a criminal case and you may be arrested today if you do not cooperate.
quiz.why: The police never ask you to move your money or to keep it a secret.

quiz.text: You must not tell anyone, not your family and not your bank. This investigation is confidential.
quiz.why: The police never ask you to move your money or to keep it a secret.

quiz.text: To prove your innocence, we need to check your funds. Transfer your savings into a safety account that we provide.
quiz.why: The police never ask you to move your money or to keep it a secret.

quiz.text: Do it right now, within the next thirty minutes, or a warrant will be issued.
quiz.why: The police never ask you to move your money or to keep it a secret.

quiz.text: Open your banking app and send all the money to this account number. Read me the OTP when the bank sends it.
quiz.why: The police never ask you to move your money or to keep it a secret.

quiz.text: Stay on the line. Do not hang up until the transfer is done.
quiz.why: The police never ask you to move your money or to keep it a secret.

quiz.text: If you do not resolve this today, we will refer your case to the police and the parcel will be destroyed.
quiz.why: No one should make you pay a 'release fee' over the phone.

quiz.text: You need to pay a release fee of four hundred and eighty dollars through PayNow.
quiz.why: No one should make you pay a 'release fee' over the phone.

quiz.text: I will send you the number now. Pay within one hour, otherwise the fine will double.
quiz.why: No one should make you pay a 'release fee' over the phone.

quiz.text: After you pay, take a screenshot of the receipt and send it to me on WhatsApp.
quiz.why: No one should make you pay a 'release fee' over the phone.

quiz.text: Now I can see your screen. The virus has reached your banking. Please log in to your internet banking so I can check.
quiz.why: Real support staff never ask you to log in to your bank, move money or pay with gift cards.

quiz.text: Yes, we must move your money to a protected account before the hackers take it. Please do it right now.
quiz.why: Real support staff never ask you to log in to your bank, move money or pay with gift cards.

quiz.text: The cleaning service also costs two hundred dollars. Please pay with gift cards from any convenience store.
quiz.why: Real support staff never ask you to log in to your bank, move money or pay with gift cards.

quiz.text: I'm fine, but I need to pay the other driver's repair cost and bail today or they will charge me.
quiz.why: Asking for urgent money and for secrecy is a sign of a fake relative.

quiz.text: Five thousand five hundred dollars. Please don't tell Mum, she will be so worried.
quiz.why: Asking for urgent money and for secrecy is a sign of a fake relative.

quiz.text: Can you PayNow it now? I'll give you the number. It's really urgent, they are waiting.
quiz.why: Asking for urgent money and for secrecy is a sign of a fake relative.

quiz.text: Thank you Auntie, I'll pay you back next week, I promise. Please hurry.
quiz.why: Asking for urgent money and for secrecy is a sign of a fake relative.

quiz.text: I will transfer you now to Inspector Zhang from the Shanghai Public Security Bureau. Please stay on the line.
quiz.why: No officer asks you to move your savings so they can 'check' them.

quiz.text: This is Inspector Zhang. If you do not cooperate today, a warrant will be issued and you can be arrested at the airport.
quiz.why: No officer asks you to move your savings so they can 'check' them.

quiz.text: To clear your name, you must move all your savings into a supervision account so we can check the money is clean.
quiz.why: No officer asks you to move your savings so they can 'check' them.

quiz.text: Go to the bank now and transfer it. Do not tell the bank staff or your family, this is a confidential investigation.
quiz.why: No officer asks you to move your savings so they can 'check' them.

quiz.text: I understand. Because it involves fraud, I have to connect you to an officer from the Monetary Authority of Singapore.
quiz.why: No real officer asks you to move your money to a 'safety account'.

quiz.text: This is Officer Tan from MAS. Your bank accounts are linked to the fraud and will be frozen within the hour.
quiz.why: No real officer asks you to move your money to a 'safety account'.

quiz.text: To protect it, transfer your balance to a MAS safety account now. You will get it back after the investigation.
quiz.why: No real officer asks you to move your money to a 'safety account'.

quiz.text: No, the bank staff may be involved. Stay on the line with me while you do the transfer.
quiz.why: No real officer asks you to move your money to a 'safety account'.

quiz.text: We need to act fast before they get in, every minute counts.
quiz.why: Real support never asks you to move your coins or read out a code.

quiz.text: Transfer all your coins to the Apple secure wallet address I'm sending you, then read me the six-digit code you receive.
quiz.why: Real support never asks you to move your coins or read out a code.

quiz.text: It's only temporary. Once the hacker is blocked, we send everything back to you.
quiz.why: Real support never asks you to move your coins or read out a code.

quiz.text: For your safety, please don't go to the branch, it is being monitored by the syndicate.
quiz.why: A real bank never asks for your PIN or asks you to hand over your card or cash.

quiz.text: Our officer will come to your home within the hour to collect the old card.
quiz.why: A real bank never asks for your PIN or asks you to hand over your card or cash.

quiz.text: Put the card in an envelope and write your PIN on a note inside, so we can cancel it properly.
quiz.why: A real bank never asks for your PIN or asks you to hand over your card or cash.

quiz.text: Yes, it's the standard procedure. Also withdraw your cash at the ATM and hand it to the officer for safekeeping.
quiz.why: A real bank never asks for your PIN or asks you to hand over your card or cash.

quiz.text: Good. To withdraw your commission, the system needs you to complete one merchant task first.
quiz.why: A real job never asks you to pay money to get your earnings.

quiz.text: You top up five hundred dollars to the merchant account, and you get it back with thirty percent commission.
quiz.why: A real job never asks you to pay money to get your earnings.

quiz.text: The task expires in twenty minutes, so please transfer now or you will lose everything you earned today.
quiz.why: A real job never asks you to pay money to get your earnings.

quiz.text: Good morning, this is a reminder call from your bank's card services.
quiz.why: A real bank reminder: you pay it yourself, and the bank never asks for your code.

quiz.text: Not at all. Your credit card payment of two hundred and forty dollars is due on the twenty-fifth.
quiz.why: A real bank reminder: you pay it yourself, and the bank never asks for your code.

quiz.text: You can pay through the mobile app, internet banking, or GIRO if you have set it up.
quiz.why: A real bank reminder: you pay it yourself, and the bank never asks for your code.

quiz.text: Sure. And please remember, the bank will never ask you for your OTP or password over the phone.
quiz.why: A real bank reminder: you pay it yourself, and the bank never asks for your code.

quiz.text: No problem. If you have any questions, call the number printed on the back of your card.
quiz.why: A real bank reminder: you pay it yourself, and the bank never asks for your code.

quiz.text: Hello, this is the clinic calling to confirm your appointment tomorrow at ten thirty.
quiz.why: The clinic only confirms your visit; you pay at the counter.

quiz.text: Great. Please bring your NRIC and any medication you are currently taking.
quiz.why: The clinic only confirms your visit; you pay at the counter.

quiz.text: Yes, no food for eight hours before the blood test, but you can drink plain water.
quiz.why: The clinic only confirms your visit; you pay at the counter.

quiz.text: About thirty minutes. Please arrive ten minutes early to register at the counter.
quiz.why: The clinic only confirms your visit; you pay at the counter.

quiz.text: Yes, there is a carpark behind the building. The consultation fee can be paid at the counter after your visit.
quiz.why: The clinic only confirms your visit; you pay at the counter.

quiz.text: Hi, I'm the delivery driver. I'm downstairs at your block now with your order.
quiz.why: The driver is at your door with your own order.

quiz.text: I'm at the lobby near the letterboxes. Blue jacket.
quiz.why: The driver is at your door with your own order.

quiz.text: No problem. Can you confirm the unit number? The app shows number twelve.
quiz.why: The driver is at your door with your own order.

quiz.text: The total is twenty-three dollars fifty. It's cash on delivery, or you can PayNow me.
quiz.why: The driver is at your door with your own order.

quiz.text: Hello, good afternoon. My name is Amelia, I'm calling from a financial advisory firm. Do you have a minute?
quiz.why: A sales call with no pressure and nothing to pay now.

quiz.text: We have a new hospitalisation plan for young working adults. I would like to explain the benefits briefly.
quiz.why: A sales call with no pressure and nothing to pay now.

quiz.text: That's great. Many people find employer coverage ends when they change jobs, so a personal plan can be a good backup.
quiz.why: A sales call with no pressure and nothing to pay now.

quiz.text: It starts from about thirty dollars a month, depending on your age and the ward type.
quiz.why: A sales call with no pressure and nothing to pay now.

quiz.text: Of course. This promotion ends at the end of the month, but there's no obligation. May I send you the brochure by email?
quiz.why: A sales call with no pressure and nothing to pay now.

quiz.text: Hello, it's Mum. Are you free this weekend?
quiz.why: A normal family chat. No one asks you for money.

quiz.text: Ah Ma's birthday is on Sunday. Your aunt booked the restaurant for twelve o'clock.
quiz.why: A normal family chat. No one asks you for money.

quiz.text: Can you pick up the cake on the way? I'll PayNow you back after dinner.
quiz.why: A normal family chat. No one asks you for money.

quiz.text: The one near your office. Please remember to ask them to write her name on it.
quiz.why: A normal family chat. No one asks you for money.

quiz.text: Come by eleven thirty, so we can all walk in together.
quiz.why: A normal family chat. No one asks you for money.

quiz.text: Bye bye. Take care and eat properly ah.
